book: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe
title: Crowned at Cair Paravel
brief: Hoo! Let’s step into Narnia one last time. In Chapter 17, Aslan crowns the four children at Cair Paravel. Build the crowning, then take a photo for your teacher.
look: This stop is the Great Hall of Cair Paravel, from Chapter 17. Aslan led the children “to the four thrones.”

models.name: Optima Domi Medieval Chair
models.why: add four, for the four thrones

models.name: Gold Crown (Optima Domi)
models.why: add two, for Peter and Edmund

steps.title: Know your models
steps.text: These are your five models. Say each name out loud. This list is also in VR, in the **Canvas** tab.

steps.title: Build it
steps.text: Press the **top button on your right controller** and click **Models**. Put **four chairs** in a row. Put a **crown** on or by each chair. Put the **lion** in front of the thrones.

steps.title: Say it out loud
steps.frame: “This throne is for ___. They were called ‘the ___’ because ___.”
steps.text: Point to one throne and say this out loud:
steps.spoken: Point to one throne and say this out loud. This throne is for… They were called the… because…

steps.title: Snap and submit
steps.fits: the four thrones, the four crowns and the lion

extra.text: Add an **Animated Deer** for the White Stag. Say what happened when the kings and queens followed it.

points: Your photo shows four thrones, four crowns and the lion.

mapday.intro: No headset today? It’s Road Map Day. Read each clue and tap who it is about. Then finish two sentences about the end of the story.
mapday.miss: Not that one. Think back to Chapters 16 and 17.
mapday.done: ✓ You know every king and queen. Now finish the two sentences.

scene.aria: The castle, with a spot for each king, queen and Aslan

clues.q: He breathes on the stone statues, and they come back to life.
He smashes the Witch’s wand with his sword.
She uses her cordial to help Edmund.
